senses.gloss: m. (apocop. reduplic. of פֶּה; cmp. פִּיפִיּוֹת) fringe, knotted to the border.
units: Kil. IX, 9 פ׳ של צמר וכ׳ (Mish. ed. פיו, corr. acc.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10) it is forbidden to attach woolen and linen fringes (to a garment), because they may be mixed up with the web; Y. ib. 32ᵈ.—Trnsf. knots surrounding the anus.
<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 7:10">Tosef. Mikv. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 8:10">VIII</cite>), 10 <he>בפ׳ או ביציאה</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <he>בסוף או בצואה</he>, read <he>בפיף</he>).
